findings.highlight: Theneven if he’s not a magus
findings.evidenceJa: ならたとえ魔術師でなくとも
findings.governingReading: Then, even if he is no magus
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses the conclusion and concession.

findings.highlight: How can I, a Master, stop them?
findings.evidenceJa: どうして止める事が出来る
findings.governingReading: how can I, as a Master, stop this
findings.explanation: The object changes from intervening in the fatal outcome to stopping both combatants.
The one attacking limb becomes plural.
The same attack target is again moved to the temple.
A speed and silence image becomes an intention to stop Kuzuki from speaking.
